high_level_description: The image features a minimalist design with a dark background. At the top of the image, there is white text that reads "Being Focused." Below the text, there is a glowing, neon-like object that resembles a pendulum or a balance scale. The object consists of two circular shapes connected by a vertical line. The upper circle is larger and positioned at the top, while the lower circle is smaller and located at the bottom. Both circles are outlined in bright white light, giving them a glowing appearance.
